data.why: StarPlot has no upload flow; it queries live Gaia DR3 photometry/astrometry from the ESA Gaia TAP archive directly from the browser for a set of curated sky targets (solar neighborhood, open clusters, globular clusters).

goals: Plot the solar neighborhood's H-R diagram and identify the Main Sequence and the White Dwarf cooling sequence
Compare a young open cluster (Pleiades) against an old open cluster (M67) to see how the Main Sequence turnoff point shifts with age
Inspect an individual star's physical properties (temperature, luminosity, radius, distance, spectral class) by hovering or clicking it
Identify the Red Giant Branch and Subgiant populations in a globular cluster like M13 or Omega Centauri
Switch color schemes to see how blackbody stellar color maps onto the color index axis
Export a high-resolution poster PNG of a chosen cluster's H-R diagram for presentation

review.summary: The tree captures the selection, navigation and export mechanics accurately, and it is candid that no stars ever loaded. But it leaves out star inspection and the diagram-reading steps that the README and the goals make central. Five of the six sampled screens match their nodes. One t1 screen shows the wrong selection, and a few specifics (export file name, data source) need correcting before filing.
